name: RC-B10-0069/2025 – After § 7 – Am 4
title: JOINT MOTION FOR A RESOLUTION on the case of Jean-Jacques Wondo in the Democratic Republic of the Congo
part_text: 7a. Stresses, more broadly, the dire security situation in the DRC; is deeply concerned by the continuous expansion and war crimes of the M23 rebels in the east; denounces the flagrant violations of the ceasefire by Rwanda and its ally, the Rwanda- and Uganda-backed M23, in particular since the capture of Masisi;
